sources.title: Simpson, Lane, Immer and Youngquist, Simple Analytic Expressions for the Magnetic Field of a Circular Current Loop (2001)
sources.access: Three-page primary paper read, including cylindrical and limiting expressions
sources.use: Exact finite-loop fields, checked independently against Biot-Savart quadrature; no dipole substitution near large circuits.

sources.title: DuPont and Murphy, Fundamental physical and resource requirements for a Martian magnetic shield (2021)
sources.access: Primary paper abstract and field/size constraint derivation read; no full scholarly review claimed
sources.use: Large current-path and conductor self-field constraints motivate the comparison. Recalculate lunar hardware with explicit engineering current density and support; do not import its atmospheric or radiation assertions or material totals.

sources.title: Green et al., A Future Mars Environment for Science and Exploration (2017)
sources.use: Primary upstream magnetotail proposal. It supplies neither a lunar wake law nor an installed hardware, control or mass budget.

sources.title: Bamford et al., How to create an artificial magnetosphere for Mars (2022; 2021 preprint)
sources.access: Abstract, methods scope and plasma-torus/current-drive discussion read
sources.use: Exploratory distributed plasma currents and guide-field requirements; loss times, instabilities and shielding remain unresolved. Recompute particle energy relativistically instead of adopting its approximate energy-speed association.

sources.title: Bamford et al., Mini-magnetospheres above the lunar surface and the formation of lunar swirls (2012)
sources.access: Primary observation/laboratory paper read in preceding electromagnetic study
sources.use: Electron-scale electrostatic deflection is physically motivated; local results supply no global downstream coverage factor.

sources.title: Khazanov et al., Fundamentals of the Plasma Sail Concept: MHD and Kinetic Studies (2003)
sources.use: Fluid inflation can misrepresent momentum transfer to the inner source; no assumed plasma-inflation multiplier or harvested power.

sources.title: Hartwig et al., The SPARC Toroidal Field Model Coil Program (2023)
sources.use: 20.1 T at 40.5 kA, metre-scale structure and 0.5-2 nOhm joints at 20 K are demonstrated. Regional loops, 100 A/mm2 engineering current density and 10 T envelope are extrapolated scenarios.

sources.title: Gunell et al., Why an intrinsic magnetic field does not protect a planet against atmospheric escape (2018)
sources.access: Publisher abstract/search text and repository treatment; direct publisher page unavailable in this run
sources.use: Open field topology, polar outflow and pickup invalidate an automatic pressure-contour-to-retention inference.

model_parameters.status: Extrapolated engineering scenarios. Sensitivities include 2.4/10/20 T, 0.01-0.1 W/m2 and COP 0.002-0.01. No system is qualified.
